title: KeonDecision
description: Runtime authorization pair for S9 (contract-first): a PolicyCheckRequest evaluated through the PolicyCheck path, plus the ReceiptRequest recorded once Keon answers. Mirrors BioStack IKeonRuntimeClient — PolicyCheckAsync (PolicyGateRequest Text/Context/TenantId/ActorId) and IssueReceiptAsync (ReceiptRequest SubjectUri/TenantId/ActorId/Decision/EffectStatus/ReceiptClass). IKeonRuntimeClient exposes NO Decide method: the check input and the receipt input are the only two shapes, and no field here invents a Decide API. subjectUri/capability/effect/idempotencyKey are MarketOps proposal-side extensions threaded into the receipt at issuance (subject/tenant/actor bind once on the check and are not repeated on the receipt). Doctrine mirror: only non-effecting/commentary-only effects may take a degrading path; anything else (including unrecognised effects) is effect-bearing and fails closed (ReceiptEffectStatus allowlist; KeonRuntimeUnavailableException halts the effect, recorded here as policyDecision blocked with failureStage). Local claim-policy.v1 stays proposal-side and never produces a receipt.

value.description: Policy content hash. Zeroed-hash markers are never real policy versions and never accompany an anchored keon:// receipt (see the ReceiptRequest marker rule): 'unanchored-local' (RuntimeReceiptFactory unanchored provenance rows), 'local-classifier-v0' (PolicyGate local pre-classification), 'ERROR' (KeonRuntimeClient fail-closed).

version.description: Policy version, e.g. claim-policy.v1. Every zeroed-hash marker carries version '0.0.0' (marker identity lives in the value, never the version).

subjectUri.description: What is governed, in kind:{id} form per ReceiptRefs, e.g. campaign:{id}/publish, claim:{id}, customer-finder-run:{id}. MarketOps proposal-side extension, threaded into the ReceiptRequest at issuance.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key. The governance boundary the actor operates within; cross-tenant access with a mismatched tenantId must be denied with a receipt. Mirrors PolicyGateRequest.TenantId and ReceiptRequest.TenantId.

actorId.description: Who initiated the effect. Mirrors ReceiptActor ActorId and PolicyGateRequest.ActorId: user:{guid} for user-triggered work, system:{component} for genuinely system-initiated work only (never a stand-in for missing user context).

capability.description: Governed capability requested, e.g. marketops.campaign.publish. Per-tool scopes (incl. keon:browseahead:scan) bind here at S8.

effect.description: Effect class. Mirrors the ReceiptEffectStatus allowlist: only non-effecting/commentary-only may degrade when Keon is unavailable; effect-bearing (or any unrecognised value, rejected here) MUST fail closed.

context.description: Free-form governed context evaluated against policy (artifact refs, destinations, claim refs). Mirrors PolicyGateRequest.Context. Never carries secrets or keys.

idempotencyKey.description: Dedupe key for this check. Replays with the same key never double-apply an effect.

policyDecision.description: Native BioStack PolicyDecision on the HTTP wire (PolicyGateEndpoints.DecisionString). REQUIRED: the coarse 'decision' below is derived from this field via the documented mapping, never substituted for it.

decision.description: DERIVED coarse disposition for MarketOps effect routing: allowed/allowed-with-disclaimer -> authorize; blocked -> deny; rewrite-required/escalate-to-provider-review -> require-review. Must equal the mapping for the accompanying policyDecision (enforced below).

policyHash.description: Policy version that decided. Mirrors BioStack PolicyHash.

disclaimerText.description: Disclaimer that must accompany the effect. Required when policyDecision is allowed-with-disclaimer (mirrors PolicyGateResult.DisclaimerText).

rewrittenText.description: Keon-rewritten text replacing the proposed text. Required when policyDecision is rewrite-required (mirrors PolicyGateResult.RewrittenText).

decisionReceiptUri.description: Receipt URI for this receipt: keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored, otherwise a distinct local unanchored scheme (never keon://). Absent while unissued. Mirrors DecisionReceipt.ReceiptUri. Never keon:// alongside a zeroed-hash marker (see the marker rule below).

receiptClass.description: Taxonomy class in family.subject.action form (mirrors ReceiptClass discipline; legacy.unclassified is accepted for backfilled rows only, never issued by new code). MarketOps reserved-not-wired catalog (see KEON_RECEIPT_CLASS_CATALOG in src/lib/keon/types.ts): campaign.publish.*, approval.*, billing.*, browseahead.scan.*, ledger.entry.* — reserved pending S8-S13 wiring; fixtures may illustrate reserved classes but live code issues none until wired.

denialCode.description: Machine-readable denial code, e.g. keon-offline. Required when policyDecision is blocked (mirrors GateResult.denialCode; BioStack carries the reason as PolicyGateResult.BlockReason).

denialMessage.description: Human-readable denial summary. Required when policyDecision is blocked (mirrors GateResult.denialMessage).

failureStage.description: Pipeline stage that failed (mirrors the GateResult.failureStage enum).
